## Trump administration fights trade judge’s order for refunds to all importers

US President Donald Trump’s administration is appealing a ruling that would require the US government to refund tariffs to all importers who paid International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) tariffs.

The US government collected around $166 billion in duties imposed under the law, before they were ruled illegal by the US Supreme Court in February.
